title: NextActionsControllerContract
description: Owns the list of suggested next actions the assistant offers the user. Exposes a selectAction action for the frontend to signal which action the user picked.

NextActionsState.title: NextActionsState
NextActionsState.description: The list of suggested actions to render. Owned exclusively by the backend; the frontend must not mutate this directly.
NextActionsState.$comment: This schema validates the runtime state value the backend pushes to the frontend.

actions.description: Suggested actions the assistant offers the user.

SelectActionAction.title: selectAction
SelectActionAction.description: Signals that the user selected one of the suggested actions.

text.description: The display text of the action the user selected.

type.description: The kind of action selected: "followup" or "search".
